title: Amazon Announces Second Quarter Results
publisher: Amazon.com, Inc. via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Net sales increased 20% year-over-year. Operating income was $27.5 billion, up 43% year-over-year.
summary: The SEC-hosted Q2 2026 release reports 20% net-sales growth to USD 200.6 billion and 43% operating-income growth to USD 27.5 billion. North America, International, and AWS sales grew 16%, 15%, and 37%; their operating income was USD 9.1 billion, USD 1.7 billion, and USD 16.6 billion. Reported net income of USD 62.6 billion included USD 53.4 billion of non-operating pre-tax income primarily from Anthropic. Trailing free cash flow was a USD 7.6 billion outflow because AI-related property investment increased sharply. Q3 guidance calls for USD 197-202 billion of sales and USD 22.5-26.5 billion of operating income.
